excerpts.line: Welcome to the BC Veteran Services and Programs
window: BC Electronic Certification Request for VA Educational Benefits
Welcome to the BC Veteran Services and Programs
Bakersfield College honors and supports the sacrifices of those who have served in
our Nation's military and is approved as an institution of higher learning for the
training of veterans and dependents of veterans who are entitled to educational assistance.

excerpts.line: BC's Peace Initiative & Veterans Resource Center invite you to join this online webinar
window: Wednesday, Nov. 10, 2021 10 AM - 11 AM | Live via Zoom
BC's Peace Initiative & Veterans Resource Center invite you to join this online webinar
to hear from a group of veteran leaders in our community. They will share stories
and experiences of finding peace after military service and being role models for
veterans, both young and old, that are often on their own journeys to finding peace.

excerpts.line: To help student veterans in their educational path, BC's Veterans Resource Center
window: Stock the Locker - Veteran School Supply Drive
Nov. 23, 2021 10:00 AM - 3 PM | Panorama Campus Parking Lot P3 on corner of Panorama
To help student veterans in their educational path, BC's Veterans Resource Center
will hold a drive-thru school supply drive. Stock the Locker will set BC's current
and future veterans up for success by supplying them with basic school supplies.

excerpts.line: and timeline for the new Veterans Resource Center in November 2018. In December 2019,
window: The Panorama Campus was built in 1956, and since that time, we have experienced tremendous
growth in both overall student population and the number of student Veterans that
we serve. Following the passage of Measure J, Bakersfield College unveiled the plans
and timeline for the new Veterans Resource Center in November 2018. In December 2019,
we opened the doors to the new center.

excerpts.line: Veteran Resource Center in October, 2018. We are proud the KCCD Board of Trustees
window: Lee L. Caldwell, Student Veteran - read Caldwell's entire speech
Upon nearing the groundbreaking, the Kern Community College District unanimously voted
to approve the naming of the new VRC to The Bakersfield College Vernon Valenzuela
Veteran Resource Center in October, 2018. We are proud the KCCD Board of Trustees
voted to name the center after a local veteran advocate, inspirational leader, and
Renegade. Vernon Valenzuela left a lasting legacy, for the Home of the Renegades,
but also for his extended community, and in the hearts of all who knew him. His life's
